subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Face the music

options.text: Listening to melodies from music albums
To face the unpleasant consequences of one's actions

solution:
The correct answer is "**To face the unpleasant consequences of one's actions**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Among the given options, option 4 correctly explains the given idiom.
 
• "Face the music" means to accept responsibility for one's actions and deal with the negative consequences.
 
• अपने कार्यों की जिम्मेदारी स्वीकार करना और नकारात्मक परिणामों से निपटना.
 
• The idiom originated from the tradition of military drummers being punished by being made to play their instruments while being publicly shamed.
 
 
• Example: After getting caught cheating on the exam, John had to face the music and accept the failing grade.
 
 

Hence, **the correct answer is option 4**.
